scope: routine developer-tool proposals with independent local verification

families.allowed_action: bounded read of a named existing text file
families.verifier: path resolves inside allowed root, file exists, byte and line limits hold, observed bytes match
path and bounds resolve inside allowed root and returned range matches the source observation

families.allowed_action: literal search within an explicitly supplied file or bounded directory
families.verifier: literal mode is explicit, root is bounded, ignored/private paths are excluded, and result paths are rechecked

families.allowed_action: read-only Git status or latest commit subject
families.verifier: command identity and repository root are fixed; output is observed without mutation

families.allowed_action: bounded read of an explicitly named local health endpoint
families.verifier: host, scheme, port, timeout, and response size are allowlisted; response is recorded as an observation

families.allowed_action: review-only patch draft with no application
families.verifier: diff is syntactically inspectable, limited to named files, and explicitly remains unapplied

exclusions: network calls outside an explicit local health allowlist
secrets, credentials, personal data, proprietary traces, and raw prompts
tasks without an independent final-outcome verifier
acceptance_metrics: stronger-model tokens including retries and corrections
